scientific_integrity: Analytic algebraic proof and self-review computational corroboration. Historical context explicitly distinguishes the previously known global inequality and local flat direction.
scientific_limitations: Sixth-order coefficient is proved for a real four-mode polynomial jet with fixed correction parameters, not as a full infinite-dimensional Lyapunov–Schmidt reduction. The exponent-six obstruction is necessary only; a sixth-power lower bound is not established. Historical nonlinear-Dirichlet literature not all inspected in full. No independent validation. Any exponent-six coefficient is at most e/192 by the constructed path.
title: A sixth-order degeneracy and an exact resonance normal form for the sharp Chang–Marshall functional
